system.description: Sacred two-handed spear: damage 1d10 (OR 7) + 8, PV 30, BV 300, IM −2, weapon actions 4. The wielder receives +6 PV while equipped and +4 SV on all tests using this weapon. Hits reduce the target’s combined PV by 3. Strength applies normally to damage. The wielder may attempt to parry targeted spells with the Parry action; the GM resolves this. The legendary reversal of negative traits remains at the GM’s discretion. The spear disappears with the power.
system.summary: Conjures a temporary sacred spear in the inventory.
